translations.web: By this we know love, because he laid down his life for us. And we ought to lay down our lives for the brothers.
translations.bsb: By this we know what love is: Jesus laid down His life for us, and we ought to lay down our lives for our brothers.
translations.kjv: Hereby perceive we the love of God, because he laid down his life for us: and we ought to lay down our lives for the brethren.
translations.asv: Hereby know we love, because he laid down his life for us: and we ought to lay down our lives for the brethren.
